setting.description: A mountain observatory and the small town below it, present day.

visible.role: A visiting data analyst on a short contract.

attractors: The participant accumulates evidence faster than any single explanation can absorb it.
invariants: Every piece of evidence stays compatible with at least two explanations until late, and some of it is noise.
No one at the observatory knows the whole story.
secrets: What happened has a mundane cause and a meaningful consequence, and the two are easy to confuse.
